Maximize Your Email Marketing Impact with iContact
Revolutionize your marketing strategy with iContact, the ultimate email marketing platform designed to boost engagement and drive conversions. Seamlessly manage campaigns, analyze performance, and personalize every interaction to captivate your audience. Join thousands of satisfied customers and unlock your brand’s full potential with iContact’s easy email marketing platform today.
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI-Powered Content Assistant
 
 
 
Say goodbye to writer’s block and hello to impactful emails that resonate with your subscribers—our AI-powered content assistant is your secret weapon for crafting compelling email content. Our content assistant uses the latest artificial intelligence technology to suggest personalized content ideas to keep your audience engaged.
View all features
 
 
 
 
Drag + Drop Builder
 
 
 
With iContact’s drag-and-drop builder, designing stunning email campaigns has never been easier. Simply drag elements like images, text, and buttons onto your canvas, customize them to your heart’s content, and watch your vision come to life.
View all features
 
 
 
 
Contact Management
 
 
 
From segmenting your audience based on demographics and behavior to automating personalized interactions, iContact’s easy email marketing platform puts the power of precision targeting at your fingertips. Our intuitive interface lets you easily import, store, and update your contact lists in one central location. Effortlessly create custom segments based on behaviors, interactions, and more to deliver personalized campaigns your audience will remember.
View all features

“I’ve been a faithful iContact customer since 2011. In that time I’ve sent out a weekly eblast every single week without fail. iContact is my primary source of marketing for my retail seafood and wine market, and I would be lost without it. While there are other formats available, and at times I’ve certainly considered switching over, I don’t regret sticking with iContact.
Customer support is one of their greatest strengths, and down through the years I’ve certainly taken advantage of their expertise and have never been turned away from a phone call or had an email inquiry not returned in a reasonable amount of time.”

Exceptional Support
Experience exceptional support with iContact’s dedicated customer service team. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned marketer, we can guide you every step of the way.

Easiest email marketing platform for small businesses
See why thousands of businesses love iContact. Get started with a free account. No credit card required.
Sign Up Now!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Simple tools that let you put the right emails in front of the right people
Smart email marketing should not be hard. Build and send email newsletters, create automation campaigns and stay in front of your customers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Bulk email campaigns
Easily import your contacts, design beautiful emails and send campaigns to your list without any of the hassle or complexities of code.
 
 
 
 
 
Scheduled emails
Send emails on specific dates and times to your customers. From birthday emails to payment reminders. Schedule them all.
 
 
 
 
 
Email automation
Simplify your marketing with intuitive email automation based on conditions and custom engagement rules.
 
 
 
 
 
Re-engagement emails
Bring back lost and disengaged customers by sending re-engagement campaigns without having to setup manual lists.
 
 
 
 
 
Email autoresponders
Send emails as and when a contact joins your marketing lists and welcome them to your business with customized greetings.
 
 
 
 
 
Triggered emails
Trigger emails based on various preset conditions and engagement events like email opens, clicks and landing page visits.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Creating and sending stunning newsletters hasn’t ever been this easy
You don’t need to know how to code to send beautiful emails. Our drag-and-drop email builder lets you craft gorgeous emails in minutes.
Sign Up Now!
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Build fast and build easily with stunning email templates
Use one of our professionally designed email templates or start from scratch using convenient layouts that allow you to create that perfect design for your brand.
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Send what your customers actually want to hear from you
Never send another generic email again. Personalize your emails with relevant information, custom data and even send times so your customers get what they want to see from you.
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Personalization
Personalization without the setup overhead. Easily craft custom emails for each contact based on related information.
 
 
 
 
 
Segmentation
Easily create segments based on contact information and past engagement with your email campaigns and landing pages.
 
 
 
 
 
Custom fields
Go levels deeper with custom fields where you can use information unique to your business to further personalize your emails.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Easy and capable tools to grow your audience
Market your brand, capture leads, sync customer lists and grow your audience with tools designed to make marketing easy and intuitive.
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
It connects to your business world
You can connect 100+ apps and software to iContact: Sync your contacts, update lists, automate campaigns, and enrich your data.
View All Integrations
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
All the data and testing you need to find that perfect message
Know what is happening and when it is happening with detailed reporting on your campaign performance, subscriber growth and landing page engagement.
Learn More
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Campaign reports
Easily understand what is working and what is not with detailed campaign reports. Track opens, clicks, unsubscribes and more.
 
 
 
 
 
Landing page analytics
View traffic, engagement and form conversion data for your landing pages and optimize them for better performance and relevancy.
 
 
 
 
 
A/B testing
Split test your campaigns before you send to your entire list to see which message will resonate better with your audience.

“I’ve been a faithful iContact customer since 2011. In that time I’ve sent out a weekly eblast every single week without fail. iContact is my primary source of marketing for my retail seafood and wine market, and I would be lost without it. While there are other formats available, and at times I’ve certainly considered switching over, I don’t regret sticking with iContact.

Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
Can I change my plan later?
 
 
Yes, we allow you to upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.
 
 
 
 
What are the main differences between the plans?
 
 
Our Premium plan offers access to all of our features, with limited restrictions. Our Standard plan will restrict access to some features as well as add limits to the amount of lists, segments, automations and landing pages you have.
 
 
 
 
Is there a limit to the number of emails I can send?
 
 
Yes, each of our plans has sending limits based off the amount of contacts included in your plan. If you go over your monthly sending limits, you will be charged overages for the send.
 
 
 
 
How does billing work?
 
 
Our billing is monthly on the first of every month for monthly plans. For annual plans, we bill on the first of the month annually. When you sign up you will be billed a prorated monthly amount.
